title: Pre-Analysis — Stiffened Hinge Beam and Aft Intercostals for the Fan Cowl Doors
abstract: Re-analysis of the stiffened fan cowl door standard, opened to consider extending it to the CVX-7270 door and rejected when the door geometry was shown to be different enough to need its own design.

sections.objective: Establish whether the stiffened hinge beam standard developed for the Auran door can be extended to the CVX-7270 door, which has reported the same closing difficulty at a lower rate, and identify what would have to change if it could.
sections.findings_summary: The extension was rejected. The CVX-7270 door carries its hinge fittings at different stations and the aft intercostal positions of the Auran standard fall on a rib rather than in a bay, so the drilling template cannot be reused and the spar cap length is wrong. What began as an effectivity extension is in fact a new design, and the reported event rate on the CVX-7270 door does not currently justify one. Two further items were confirmed and remain valid. The published hinge beam repair scheme excludes a door already carrying the spar cap and that exclusion is correctly stated. The removal task records the aft hinge distortion measurement, which is the data that would justify a CVX-7270 design if the rate rises, and that step must be retained on all doors and not only on Auran doors.
sections.next_steps: Do not extend the standard to the CVX-7270 door. Retain the distortion measurement step on all doors so that the data continues to be collected. Review the position when the CVX-7270 measurement population reaches the size used for the Auran decision.

tasks.title: Compare the hinge station geometry between door variants
Assess the CVX-7270 event and measurement population

expected_findings.rationale: The repair scheme puts a splice plate exactly where the spar cap lands, and it correctly excludes a door already carrying the spar cap. It was reviewed because an extension would have brought a second door population into the same conflict.
expected_findings.resolution: No change. The exclusion is correctly stated and remains valid.

expected_findings.rationale: The removal task records the aft hinge distortion measurement. That measurement is the only fleet-wide data on the condition and it must continue to be taken on doors of both variants, not only on the ones being converted.
expected_findings.resolution: Retain the step for all doors and make the applicability explicit in the effectivity note.

expected_non_findings.reason: Same door, same ATA 6D and directly dependent on the stiffened standard, but it is a mass recovery proposal for the Auran door and says nothing about the CVX-7270 variant that this analysis was opened for.

type_data.conclusion: Extension rejected. A CVX-7270 door change would be a new design and the event rate does not support one.
